response.overview: To speak directly with a Royal Caribbean Cruise Line representative, call ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698-2211(US) (1-877-Royal Caribbean) using theRoyal Caribbean Cruise Line Customer Care Portal.Phone Contact Details & Hours General Reservations & Support: ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698-2211(US) (1-800-Royal Caribbean) Hours: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Monday – Friday, Pacific Time) Hours: 6:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Saturday and Sunday, Pacific Time) Dine Line: ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698-2211(US) (1-833-805-DINE) Alaska Cruisetour Assistance: ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698-2211(US) Corporate Meetings & Incentive Groups: ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698-2211(US) (7:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mon–Fri Pacific Time) Tips for Reaching a Live Agent Menu prompts: When calling the main line ⚜ USA ✧ +1-877-698 2211(US) , stay on the line or avoid pressing extra extension buttons if you want to bypass automated options
